ctx.x: He plays everything. He plays soprano sax and he played piano and could arrange, now during this time Duke he was in Deanwood, see, now the big bands, Claude Hopkins, he was a big band, and then they had a band called Sam Taylor's and Sam Taylor would give you a little trouble and they had one called Cyrus Carter's Jazzhounds. Those days they had -- they all had names, just awful names. Blues Stompers, Barefoot Ramblers and one band was named Sam somebody and his Yarddogs.

So now Sam Taylor, he was -- you don't go in Southwest and bother Sam Taylor, he'd get you and this -- and Cyrus Carter, he'd get you if you go in Northwest, so that was -- and then they had the White Brothers, they were society. You didn't bother with me, and they all read music. Cyrus Carter wasn't studying about no music, and was swinging and going on --
